outputs.explanation: These are spatial heatmap-style plots showing per-spot deconvolution scores overlaid on tissue images; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Box plots quantifying immune cell fractions, which are exempt from the requirement, and individual data points (dots) are additionally overlaid on each box.
GSEA enrichment score line plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values for each gene derived from aggregated differential expression analysis across many spatial spots, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel consists of representative H&E and IHC micrograph/photograph images, not a quantitative plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
